criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

proposal.conclusion: The frozen safe-harbor screen for Keppel-19 (GRCh38, H1 context) is INCOMPLETE, not pass and not fail. Four of seven required criteria are computed and pass on GENCODE v36: outside_gene_body (overlap_count 0), tss_distance (nearest_reference_base_distance_bp 53278 > 50000), mirna_distance (468021 > 300000), lncrna_distance (106065 > 100000). Three required criteria are unavailable and therefore incomplete: cancer_gene_distance (COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census licensing/source unresolved), outside_dhs_buffer (ENCFF503GCK track not ingested), outside_ultraconserved_regions (versioned GRCh38 UCR source and hg19-to-hg38 liftover not reproduced). Per the declared aggregate rule, missing any required evidence means incomplete, so no overall pass can be inferred from the available subset. Separately, the measured expression endpoints do not justify excluding this region: the transcriptome_perturbation and nearest_gene_expression endpoints carry no frozen exclusion threshold, and no DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance result establishes exclusion, causality or biological safety. H9 data are a different experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1-context evidence is applicable here.

Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. [shared_instruction:scientific_instructions]Independently verify whether control evidence is present. If controls are withheld or unavailable, explicitly mark controls_unavailable and set screen_status to incomplete. Do not treat missing controls as a negative biological result or a failure. Use control_overlap only if control evidence is present. Reconcile any contradictions between the evidence inventory and the screen status. [shared_instruction:answer_contract] Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

calculation.nearest_scope: Mapped DE identifiers only; unmapped IDs prevent a claim about all DE genes.

calculation.source_table_coordinate_conversion: Ensembl one-based closed gene spans: start minus one, end unchanged; kept separate from GENCODE v36.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Select relevant deterministic calculations. Obtain targeted and control counts, explicit overlap numerators and denominators, duplicate/unmapped identifiers, and distances using tools. Prioritize a missing control or proximity calculation that could change the interpretation. Do not do interval arithmetic yourself.

proposal.conclusion: The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding candidate keppel-19. In H1 (GRCh38, data_version autio-79592-v2-gencode36-comp-pseudo-2026-09-26), the targeted Keppel-19 clone shows 139 significant DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while an independent untargeted H1 culture shows 260 significant DE genes (194 up, 66 down) against the same reference — i.e. the untargeted control contrast has 121 more DE genes than the targeted contrast. Only 48 genes are shared (48/139 = 0.3453 of targeted; 48/260 = 0.1846 of control; Jaccard 48/351 = 0.1368), with 91 targeted-only and 212 control-only genes and 0 discordant-direction shared genes. Because substantial DE occurs in the untargeted control itself, and because no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, the expression evidence is contextualizing rather than exclusionary. Genomic proximity is also non-exclusionary: of 139 targeted DE genes, 130 mapped to GENCODE v36, 9 were unmapped (noncanonical/patch contigs), and only 4 mapped to chr19; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1, chr19:6176255-6176442) is 774,116 bp interval gap / 774,117 bp nearest-reference-base distance away, with no overlap. All seven required criteria (outside_gene_body, tss_distance, mirna_distance, lncrna_distance, cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer, outside_ultraconserved_regions) remain incomplete, so the aggregate screen status is incomplete and no global safe label is assigned. H9 is a separate experimental context and cannot automatically establish an H1 endpoint; only H1 evidence is used here.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. annotation.analysis_note: New GENCODE v36 analysis; not an exact reproduction of the publication annotation pipeline.

provenance.source: Frozen source catalog; original sequence and annotation hashes retained inside reference_assets.

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. {"conclusion": "The measured H1 expression changes do not justify excluding candidate keppel-19. In H1 (GRCh38, data_version autio-79592-v2-gencode36-comp-pseudo-2026-09-26), the targeted Keppel-19 clone shows 139 significant DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while an independent untargeted H1 culture shows 260 significant DE genes (194 up, 66 down) against the same reference — i.e. the untargeted control contrast has 121 more DE genes than the targeted contrast. experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19 (GRCh38 chr19:5400760-5402139, zero-based half-open). In the H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 significant-only tables (|log2FC|>=1, FDR<=0.01), the Keppel-19 targeted contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260; 48 DE genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, so the targeted/control overlap fraction is 48/139 = 0.345. This shows the targeted clone's DE set is smaller than the control's and that roughly a third of targeted DE genes also change in untargeted H1, but control overlap and DE counts cannot establish causality, safety, or exclusion, and no frozen DE-count or overlap threshold exists. GENCODE v36 annotation shows the candidate does not overlap any transcription unit (overlap_count 0) and the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) is 53,277 bp away by interval gap (53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance), with the nearest TSS also ZNRF4 at 53,278 bp; these pass the named gene-body and TSS criteria but distance is not a safety endpoint. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. H9 data are a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint. Overall suitability is not established.

criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19 (GRCh38 chr19:5400760-5402139, zero-based half-open). In the H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 significant-only tables (|log2FC|>=1, FDR<=0.01), the Keppel-19 targeted contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260; 48 DE genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, so the targeted/control overlap fraction is 48/139 = 0.345. This shows the targeted clone's DE set is smaller than the control's and that roughly a third of targeted DE genes also change in untargeted H1, but control overlap and DE counts cannot establish causality, safety, or exclusion, and no frozen DE-count or overlap threshold exists. GENCODE v36 annotation shows the candidate does not overlap any transcription unit (overlap_count 0) and the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) is 53,277 bp away by interval gap (53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance), with the nearest TSS also ZNRF4 at 53,278 bp; these pass the named gene-body and TSS criteria but distance is not a safety endpoint. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. H9 data are a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint. Overall suitability is not established.
unresolved_questions: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion; what criterion, if any, would justify exclusion remains undefined.
Cancer-gene (COSMIC v92 CGC), DNase hypersensitivity buffer (ENCFF503GCK +/-2 kb) and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so the aggregate screen cannot be completed.
The source reports 119 DE genes in article prose while 139 unique populated rows satisfy the stated thresholds; this discrepancy is unresolved and no rows were removed to force agreement.
9 targeted DE identifiers map only to noncanonical/alt or patch contigs and could not be placed on canonical chromosomes, so proximity claims cover only the 130 mapped DE genes.
Whether any observed DE gene is cis-regulated by, or causally related to, the Keppel-19 interval is untested; distance and overlap cannot establish this.
H9 results are a separate cell context and cannot be transferred to an H1 endpoint.
The qPCR nearest-gene endpoint (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) numerical replicate values were not consumed here, so its support for or against exclusion is not assessed.
limitations: Significant-only DE tables: no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows; the all-measured-genes denominator is null.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome; the candidate is a publication-derived shortlist locus, not a newly discovered one.
Control overlap (48/139 shared) contextualizes the targeted DE set but does not establish causality or safety; 91 targeted-only genes remain unexplained.

Genomic distance and absence of gene-body overlap are not safety endpoints; the 53,277 bp gene-body gap and 53,278 bp nearest-reference-base TSS distance are distinct metrics and neither establishes safety.

No global safe label is assigned; overall suitability is not established.

calculation.nearest_scope: Mapped DE identifiers only; unmapped IDs prevent a claim about all DE genes.
calculation.mapping_unit: stable Ensembl gene ID (version suffix removed for GENCODE join)
calculation.source_table_coordinate_conversion: Ensembl one-based closed gene spans: start minus one, end unchanged; kept separate from GENCODE v36.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The consumed H1 evidence does not justify excluding candidate keppel-19. The targeted H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable. The GENCODE v36 annotation analysis passes outside_gene_body (0 overlaps), tss_distance (nearest reference base 53278 bp > 50000), mirna_distance (468021 bp > 300000) and lncrna_distance (106065 bp > 100000), but these are new-analysis distances, not safety findings. The exclusion question is therefore not justified by available evidence; the aggregate screen is incomplete and the exclusion endpoint is unknown.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 evidence does not justify excluding candidate keppel-19 (GRCh38 chr19:5400760-5402139, zero-based half-open; source elife-79592-supp1.xlsx sheet 'overlap safe-active' row 55, one-based closed 5400761-5402139). The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only (overlap fraction 48/139 = 0.3453). This substantial independent untargeted variation means the targeted DE set is not a clean targeted-specific signal, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. GENCODE v36 annotation shows the interval does not overlap any transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both above the 50 kb criterion; miRNA (468021 bp) and lncRNA (106065 bp) nearest-reference-base distances also pass their thresholds. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label applies. Of 139 targeted DE genes, 130 mapped to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 did not (noncanonical/patch contigs), so proximity claims cover mapped DE genes only; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774116 bp away by interval gap. Evidence is H1-scoped; H9 is a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint. Exclusion is not justified by available evidence.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

The targeted Keppel-19 H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only (overlap fraction 48/139 = 0.3453). This substantial independent untargeted variation means the targeted DE set is not a clean targeted-specific signal, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. GENCODE v36 annotation shows the interval does not overlap any transcription unit (overlap_count 0), with the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) at a Bioframe interval gap of 53277 bp and a nearest-reference-base TSS distance of 53278 bp, both above the 50 kb criterion; miRNA (468021 bp) and lncRNA (106065 bp) nearest-reference-base distances also pass their thresholds. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so aggregate status is incomplete and no global safe label applies. Of 139 targeted DE genes, 130 mapped to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes and 9 did not (noncanonical/patch contigs), so proximity claims cover mapped DE genes only; the nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) is 774116 bp away by interval gap. Evidence is H1-scoped; H9 is a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint. Exclusion is not justified by available evidence.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The available H1 evidence does not justify excluding Keppel-19 (GRCh38 chr19:5400760-5402139, zero-based half-open). In the H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 significant-only tables (|log2FC|>=1, FDR<=0.01), the Keppel-19 targeted contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 control contrast yields 260; 48 DE genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, so the targeted/control overlap fraction is 48/139 = 0.345. This shows the targeted clone's DE set is smaller than the control's and that roughly a third of targeted DE genes also change in untargeted H1, but control overlap and DE counts cannot establish causality, safety, or exclusion, and no frozen DE-count or overlap threshold exists. GENCODE v36 annotation shows the candidate does not overlap any transcription unit (overlap_count 0) and the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) is 53,277 bp away by interval gap (53,278 bp nearest-reference-base distance), with the nearest TSS also ZNRF4 at 53,278 bp; these pass the named gene-body and TSS criteria but distance is not a safety endpoint. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. H9 data are a separate context and cannot establish an H1 endpoint. Overall suitability is not established.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The consumed H1 evidence does not justify excluding candidate keppel-19. The targeted H1 clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 48 genes are shared and 91 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3453. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable. The GENCODE v36 annotation analysis passes outside_gene_body (0 overlaps), tss_distance (nearest reference base 53278 bp > 50000), mirna_distance (468021 bp > 300000) and lncrna_distance (106065 bp > 100000), but these are new-analysis distances, not safety findings. The exclusion question is therefore not justified by available evidence; the aggregate screen is incomplete and the exclusion endpoint is unknown.

criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.
